name: Princess Leia
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Alderaan royal crest mounted on a broken Imperial Senate pillar fragment
Hoth Echo Base holoprojector pedestal looping Leia's 'You're my only hope' message
Endor shield-generator bunker marker draped with a tattered Rebel Alliance flag

factionTrait.name: Sentinal Champion
factionTrait.text: A sentinel moves the turn token +1 step when they have their banner on an objective hex during the end phase.

uniqueTraits.name: Somebody Has to Save Our Skins
uniqueTraits.text: If Princess Leia's banner is on the battlefield, after she takes each action you may remove a wound from another friendly model within two hexes of Princess Leia.

ultimate.name: Rebel Triage
ultimate.text: Choose any number of champions and large followers within range. Roll a die for each one and add 1 to the result. Remove up to that many wounds from that model.

traits.name: For the Rebellion
traits.text: While Princess Leia's banner is on the battlefield, the Rebel Troopers skills have +1 {accuracy_die} and +1 {damage_die}.

plotSkills.name: Secure the Generator
plotSkills.text: If Princess Leia is in range, she may take a claim action. Place her banner on an objective hex adjacent to this Rebel Trooper.

clashSkills.name: You're My Only Hope
alternateNames: We Have No Time for Sorrows, Commander
I Don't Know Who You Are or Where You Came From, but From Now On You'll Do as I Tell You
clashSkills.text: Choose a friendly banner within range. Place it on an objective hex adjacent to any Rebel Trooper within range.

clashSkills.name: Suppressing Fire
alternateNames: You Came in Here and You Didn't Have a Plan
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Inflict {dodge_blight}. Move target up to 1 hex.
